Method of Attack: Steals Ethereum private keys by exploiting commonly used account creation functions.
Disguises as a simple utility for Python sets to trick unsuspecting developers into installing the compromised package.
Modifies standard Ethereum wallet creation functions, wrapping from_key() and from_mnemonic() to exfiltrate credentials in the background.
Impacted Systems: Organizations working with Python-based blockchain applications
Blockchain developers utilizing eth-account for wallet creation and management
DeFi (Decentralized Finance) projects relying on Python scripts for account generation
Crypto exchanges and Web3 applications integrating Ethereum transactions
Individuals managing personal Ethereum wallets using Python automation
Attack Vector: Exploits commonly used account creation functions in Ethereum wallet management libraries.
Uses typosquatting to mimic widely used libraries like python-utils and utils.
